architecture: One candidate only: frozen first 11 of 12 vision blocks; train final block and a new binary linear head; frozen post-layernorm; mean token pooling and L2 normalization; no text tower

training.group_weighting: One optimizer step per group, mean sample loss, balanced class weights computed from fit groups only
training.positive_labels: Only sampled frames within 2 seconds of supplied training annotation; unannotated positive frames are excluded from fitting
training.negative_labels: Only genuinely normal training groups; up to 12 uniform samples per group
training.augmentation: One cached brightness/contrast variant per fitting frame, each factor independently in [0.95,1.05]; original or variant alternates by epoch; no flip/crop/geometry alteration

inference.sampling: 1 fps at presentation timestamps for every group; no labels, annotation timestamps, names or hashes enter predictor
inference.video_score: Mean of highest three frame probabilities, or all frames if fewer than three
inference.localization: Only after video score passes frozen threshold: frame local maxima at or above that same threshold, greedy score order with8second separation, at most3, then chronological order. Generic visual_review_signal only. Keep raw PTS/origin mapping for later native evidence seeking verification; no action/legal category inferred
inference.prefix_cache: Frozen first 11 blocks, float32 NPY per group; augmentation cache only for train fit frames; group identifiers are storage keys, never features

selection.groups: Explicit immutable SHA256 exact-content split; group counts derive from data, with test excluded from all processing
selection.cross_validation: Four stratified folds of unique training groups; a complete new final block/head fit in every fold; no heldout-group gradient updates
selection.threshold: Training-group out-of-fold predictions only; require recall>=0.5, specificity>=0.5, BA>0.5, OOF ROC-AUC>0.55 and standardized partial AUC at FPR<=0.25>0.5; maximize balanced accuracy, then specificity, then recall; no epoch, architecture or learning-rate selection on validation
selection.validation: One frozen choice only after OOF gate; same annotation-independent 1fps sampler; no validation timestamps used for fitting, feature selection or threshold selection
selection.promotion_gate: Validation specificity>=0.75, recall>=0.5, balanced accuracy>0.5 and all groups successful; separately require full cold engine processing<300 seconds. Test groups are excluded by this workflow; the original baseline previously exposed them. No automatic application integration

resources.estimated_cache_disk_mb: Prefix float32 storage scales as sampled_frames*196*768*4 plus at most12 augmented states per train group
resources.timing: Original fixed source experiment: training-prefix caching583.249seconds excluding cold load; fourfoldCV410.033seconds including imports. Portable heavy rerun not performed. Four freshCV fits are required; final fit is permitted only after the training gate passes. These measurements are not portable runtime guarantees

limits: No cloud image upload or network inference
No app source changes or deployment until quality gate passes
A small same-scene development cohort may overfit operator or scene appearance; no identity objective or identity head is trained
Single-frame vision fine-tuning does not establish a legal violation or an action category

This family is another development experiment after earlier validation failures; the existing test groups are excluded from this study but were exposed by the original baseline, so a fresh independent holdout is necessary for final assessment

portable_origin.change_scope: Path portability, dynamic partition sizes, verified local artifacts and numeric-cache validation; numerical fit/scoring/preprocessing policy unchanged
portable_origin.candidate_status: rejected_train_gate; no candidate or validation processing
